data.one_liner: Analyze and diff public APIs of Dart packages to check semantic versioning.
data.what_it_does: Dart API Tool analyzes the public API of a package, creates a model of it, and compares it against another version. It helps maintainers verify that version numbers follow semantic versioning correctly by detecting breaking changes.
use_when: You want to automate semver checking in your package CI pipeline.
You need to compare public APIs between different package versions, git branches, or local directories.
avoid_when: You need a general-purpose linter or formatter for source code.
You want to analyze implementation details or internal logic rather than public APIs.
strengths: Supports local paths, pub.dev packages, and Git repositories with specific tags or branches.
Integrates smoothly into CI workflows to catch accidental breaking changes early.
weaknesses: It cannot cover all potential API changes or look into internal implementations.
Relies heavily on the accuracy of the analyzer and public exports.
data.setup_notes: Install globally via dart pub global activate dart_apitool.
